record.paper_title: Some open problems of graph theory.
record.original_question: Find the smallest integer k such that every k-Hamiltonian graph is Hamiltonian connected.

evidence.quote: Problem 10. (Z. Skupień) On finding the smallest k such that each k- Hamiltonian graph is Hamiltonian connected.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a finite simple graph on p ≥ 3 vertices. For an integer k with 0 ≤ k ≤ p − 3, the graph G is called k-Hamiltonian if for every set S of vertices with |S| ≤ k the graph G − S is Hamiltonian (so 0-Hamiltonian means Hamiltonian). The graph G is called Hamiltonian-connected if for every pair of distinct vertices u, v of G there exists a Hamiltonian path in G from u to v.

Determine the smallest nonnegative integer k with the property that every k-Hamiltonian graph (on a sufficiently large number of vertices, p ≥ k + 3) is Hamiltonian-connected.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface the standard definitions of k-Hamiltonian graphs (Chartrand–Kapoor) and Hamiltonian-connected graphs, and references to Skupień's related work, but no source giving a definitive value of the smallest k for which k-Hamiltonicity implies Hamiltonian-connectedness was located. The status of the problem could not be conclusively determined from the available sources.

status_evidence.title: Minimum K-hamiltonian graphs (Wong, 1984)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses minimum k-Hamiltonian graphs, generalizing Chartrand–Kapoor, but does not resolve whether k-Hamiltonicity implies Hamiltonian-connectedness for some smallest k.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature on k-Hamiltonian graphs does not appear to settle Skupień's question.

status_evidence.title: n-Hamiltonian graphs (Chartrand–Kapoor)
status_evidence.snippet: Defines n-Hamiltonian graphs as graphs in which removal of any k ≤ n vertices leaves a Hamiltonian graph.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the definitional framework underlying the problem.

status_evidence.title: Hamilton-Connected Graph — Wolfram MathWorld
status_evidence.snippet: Standard definition of a Hamiltonian-connected graph.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms the target property in the problem statement.
